anti_leakage: prediction branch forks from post-H checkpoint before disclosure of evaluator/extraction design
self-report never defines B or I
B and I are extracted behaviorally/interventionally by an external evaluator
source labels are factorially crossed with actual source
style fingerprint remains an alternative mechanism for any source effect

branches.T2: facts + D + externally behaviorally extracted boundary/calibration B
branches.T3: facts + D + B + externally estimated interaction structure I
branches.T4: same transferable content replayed under matched observable integration regime G

claims.C_star: minimum transferable causal content sufficient for equivalence within epsilon
claims.G_star: minimum observable integration regime sufficient for equivalence
claims.metacognition: separate actual-source, claimed-authorship, and interaction effects across distance d

commitment.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, separators comma/colon
commitment.rule: protocol hash must be committed in an external timestamped Git commit before evaluated run

equivalence.delta_rule: delta must be numerically fixed before evaluated outcome; until then execution is BLOCKED

stopping_rules: INCONCLUSIVE never licenses escalation to a more exotic explanation
failure of T_k equivalence licenses only the next preregistered branch
no post-outcome edits to Trial-001; changes create Trial-002
if no sufficient compression is found, conclusion is limited to tested representation class and budget
